turn a blind eye: Teachers should never turn a blind eye to bullying, even if it seems like a small joke between students.
老師絕不應該對霸凌視而不見，即使那看起來只是學生之間的小玩笑。
turn the tables: Our team was losing by ten points, but we managed to turn the tables in the last five minutes.
我們隊落後十分，但我們在最後五分鐘成功扭轉局面。
turn down an offer: She decided to turn down an offer from a big company because she wanted to stay near her family.
她決定拒絕一家大公司的提議，因為她想留在家人附近。
turn over a new leaf: After failing three classes last year, Jason promised to turn over a new leaf and study harder this semester.
去年三科被當後，傑森承諾要改過自新，這學期更用功讀書。
turn up: We waited for an hour at the station, but Tom never turned up, so we went to the movie without him.
我們在車站等了一個小時，但湯姆一直沒出現，所以我們就不等他去看電影了。
turn to someone for help: When I have trouble with my math homework, I always turn to my older brother for help.
當我的數學作業有困難時，我總是向我哥哥求助。
turn sour: Their friendship began to turn sour after they argued about money on their trip to Japan.
他們在日本旅行時為錢爭吵後，友誼開始變質。
turn the corner: The doctor said my grandmother has finally turned the corner and should be able to leave the hospital soon.
醫生說我奶奶的病情終於好轉了，應該很快就能出院。
turn one's back on: He promised that he would never turn his back on his old friends, even after he became rich and famous.
他承諾即使在變得有錢又有名之後，也絕不會背棄他的老朋友。
tutor a student: During summer vacation, my cousin earns extra money by helping to tutor a student who is preparing for exams.
暑假期間，我表哥靠著幫一位準備考試的學生當家教來賺外快。
tutor someone in math: Since my sister is good with numbers, she agreed to tutor me in math twice a week before the final exam.
因為我姊姊數字很好，她答應在期末考前每週兩次教我數學。
be tutored privately: Instead of going to a cram school, the young tennis star was tutored privately at home because of her busy schedule.
那位年輕網球明星因為行程忙碌，沒有去補習班，而是在家接受私人家教。
twist the truth: Some news reports twist the truth to get more clicks, so we should always check other sources.
有些新聞報導為了獲得更多點閱而扭曲事實，所以我們應該總是查證其他來源。
twist someone's words: Stop twisting my words! I never said that I hated your cooking; I only said it was a little salty.
別曲解我的話！我從來沒說我討厭你做的菜，我只說有點鹹。
twist one's ankle: Be careful on the wet stairs, or you might twist your ankle and miss the basketball game this weekend.
在濕滑的樓梯上要小心，不然你可能會扭到腳踝，錯過這週末的籃球比賽。
twist someone's arm: I didn't want to sing at the party, but my friends twisted my arm until I finally agreed.
我本來不想在派對上唱歌，但我的朋友們強迫我，直到我終於答應。
a twist of fate: By a twist of fate, the two old classmates met again on a train in Europe after twenty years.
由於命運轉折，那兩位老同學在二十年後於歐洲的一班火車上重逢。
twist and turn: The mountain road began to twist and turn so much that several passengers on the bus felt sick.
山路開始如此蜿蜒曲折，以至於巴士上有好幾位乘客覺得不舒服。
a plot twist: Nobody in the theater expected a plot twist like that, when the kind doctor turned out to be the killer.
戲院裡沒有人預料到那樣的劇情反轉，原來那位和藹的醫生竟然是兇手。
uncover the truth: The reporter spent two years talking to workers in order to uncover the truth about the factory accident.
那位記者花了兩年訪談工人，為了揭露那場工廠意外的真相。
uncover a plot: Thanks to a brave worker who called the police, officers were able to uncover a plot to rob the bank.
多虧一位勇敢的員工報警，警方才得以揭發一樁搶劫銀行的陰謀。
uncover evidence: After months of research, the scientist was able to uncover evidence that the factory had polluted the river.
經過數月的研究，那位科學家發現了那家工廠污染河川的證據。
uncover a scandal: The newspaper became famous after its journalists helped uncover a scandal involving several powerful politicians.
那家報社在記者協助揭發一樁涉及數名有權勢政治人物的醜聞後聲名大噪。
uncover the remains: While building a new road, workers happened to uncover the remains of an ancient village under the ground.
在興建新道路時，工人們意外挖掘出地底下一座古老村莊的遺骸。
undergo surgery: My grandfather had to undergo surgery on his heart last month, but he is now recovering well at home.
我爺爺上個月必須動心臟手術，但他現在在家恢復得很好。
undergo change: Our town will undergo change quickly in the next ten years, as new malls and apartments are being built everywhere.
我們的小鎮在未來十年將快速經歷改變，因為到處都在興建新的購物中心和公寓。
undergo training: All new firefighters must undergo training for six months before they are allowed to fight real fires.
所有新進消防員都必須接受六個月的訓練，才被允許撲滅真正的火災。
undergo tests: Before the new medicine can be sold in stores, it must undergo tests to make sure it is safe.
新藥在能夠於商店販售之前，必須接受檢查以確保安全。
undergo a transformation: After the old factory was turned into an art center, the whole area seemed to undergo a transformation.
那座舊工廠改建成藝術中心後，整個地區似乎經歷了一場轉變。
undergo treatment: The singer canceled her world tour so that she could undergo treatment for a serious illness at the hospital.
那位歌手取消了她的世界巡迴演唱會，以便在醫院接受嚴重疾病的治療。
